name: Fujishima Kanako
source:
A runaway female student in search of a person willing to let her stay for the night. She goes after middle-aged bachelors with whom she has great success. She is the cheerful and affectionate type who is devoted to those she trusts. She has an open mind even when it comes to sex, stating that she loves sexual acts herself. She may sound like someone who goes along with men without much of a thought, but there are things she will protect no matter what, and has made it a rule to only spend one night with any one person. There seems to be a reason why she would go to such lengths to not return home...

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=835147]Getchu[/url]]
